analysis_scope: logo usage on profile covers and location pages

marks.slogan_notes: Rendered pages and the logo files show the letter O in OF. COMPANY CONTEXT.pdf text layer often stores a digit zero (GIFT 0F GOD). Preserve both. Some inner-profile logo treatments colour GIFT OF GOD red; the standalone logo files use dark blue/purple stencil lettering.

primary_wordmark_composition.container: Horizontal rectangle, bright yellow fill, thin green border.
primary_wordmark_composition.line_1: ATS — heavy slab/serif capitals, vertical blue-to-pale-blue/white gradient with a horizontal glint through the letter bodies.
primary_wordmark_composition.line_2: GIFT OF GOD — smaller all-caps stencil-serif, solid dark blue/purple in the standalone files.
primary_wordmark_composition.legal_name_outside_badge: Profile pages place ACTIVE TECHNICAL SERVICES (U) LTD. or ACTIVE TECHNICAL SERVICES LTD. under the yellow badge. The standalone logo files do not include the legal name inside the badge.

colour_observations_provisional.warning: Sampled from active logo.jpg by quantizing non-white pixels. These are provisional RGB values, not a specified brand palette.
colour_observations_provisional.corner_pixels: All four corners of the JPG are white (255,255,255).

geometry.safe_area: Substantial white margin around the yellow badge on all sides. The badge itself is a wide rectangle, roughly 3:1 visually, inset from the canvas.

pdf_versus_jpg.inference: The JPG is a 200 dpi raster export of the same CorelDRAW artwork. The PDF is outlined vectors (no live text). Prefer the PDF for production; the JPG is a preview/fallback.

on_document_variants: Cover headers add the legal name beside the badge.
Tanzania location-page logo: GIFT OF GOD appears darker/blacker in the visual reading of COMPANY CONTEXT.pdf page 33.
Some inner pages colour GIFT OF GOD red.
Tanzania footers overlap ACTIVE TECHNICIAL SERVICES (U) LTD. with ACTIVE TECHNICAL SERVICES LTD. (TECHNICIAL is source spelling).
accessibility_concerns: ATS letter bottoms fade toward pale blue/white on yellow — likely insufficient contrast at the base of the letters.
Yellow field on white canvas has weak edge contrast except for the thin green border.
Small stencil GIFT OF GOD may fail small-size rendering on screens.
Do not 'fix' the mark; later UI work should keep the artwork and add sufficient surrounding contrast or size.

recommended_production_source_file.reason: Outlined vector paths, no JPEG artefacts, smaller file, same artwork as the JPG.
